review_candidates.title: Lead Project Control, Planning and Scheduling
review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary The Future of Energy begins now. GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers power economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. In this role, you'll be responsible for developing and maintaining integrated L2/L3 project schedules for new construction, equipment delivery, and installation projects. You will support reporting and on-time delivery analysis that comply with customer requirements and adhere to internal processes and standards established by our PMO. Job Description What you'll do: Lead Handover Alignment: Participate in Inquiry-to-Order (ITO) to Order-to-Remittance (OTR) handover meetings to review contract details, analyze L1 bid schedules, and validate initial project assumptions and risk summaries. Contribute to Project Mobilization: Attend Contract Kick-Off Meetings (CKOM) and ITO-led release meetings, tracking schedule-related action items and contributing directly to Delivery Matrix development. Facilitate Commitment Meetings: Support the development of Commitment Meeting packages by synthesizing functional, project, and contractual requirements. Secure Baseline Consensus: Partner with cross-functional owners during Commitment Meetings to resolve initial schedule discrepancies, bridge operational gaps, and achieve agreement on the finalized project baseline. Baseline Schedule / KPIs Development Set up integrated project schedule (including L3/L2 and S curves) baseline working with internal GEV team and in alignment with Global Project Control, Planning and Scheduling processes. Project Schedule Maintenance Ensures schedules accurately reflect project scope and execution strategy. Continuously monitors project on time delivery performance to ensure knowledge of main issues and how issues are being mitigated. Proactively monitors project schedule to highlight slippages, inaccurate data causing erroneous forecasts/reporting and identifies corrective actions and action owner to resolve issues. Update L2/L3 project schedule based on inputs from GEV team. Perform schedule analysis on monthly basis to identify the critical impacts and provide the mitigations suggestions. Ensure WIPT is updated monthly Works with project team to identify mitigation strategies and ensure strategies are reflected in project schedule. Escalates critical project issues to the internal project manager and project team. Ensures reports for other functions and customers accurately reflect status of project equipment and provide to customer and business reporting. Communicates to functions impact of execution strategy changes and resulting changes to required dates. Acts as a resource for project team members and supports with data, analysis, and root causes of schedule variances. Uses some judgement and has some ability to propose different solutions to address more complicated project scenarios. Perform the critical path analysis for deliverables and ensure no impact to contract dates. Claims (EOT, etc.); perform delay analysis to support extension of time and cost claims. Required Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma ) with the equivalent + Min. 7 yrs of Experience in Project Control Planning & Scheduling function Proficient/highly experienced with Primavera P6 ( resources loaded schedules). What Will Make You Stand Out Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Able to work with large complex project team reviews as well as to simplify complex messages Knowledge in of power plant principles and work processes of EPC environments. Resilient and ability to work under pressure Experience of working with international teams and complex environment and open for travel up to 25% Experience in Extension of time claims / forensic planning GE Vernova is electrifying the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. To achieve this mission, we offer competitive benefits, flexible working options, and continuous career development opportunities designed to reward your performance and support your growth. Additional Information GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Relocation Assistance Provided: No This is a remote position For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $100,000.00 and $166,700.00. The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus. This posting is expected to remain open for at least seven days after it was posted on November 24, 2026. Available benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to Health Coach from GE Vernova, a 24/7 nurse-based resource; and access to the Employee Assistance Program, providing 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Vernova Retirement Savings Plan, a tax-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and financial planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability benefits, life insurance, 12 paid holidays, and permissive time off.
